unsupported_or_nonsynthesizable.description: 时序块内非阻塞赋值带 #Tp 延迟（如 rtl/spi_top.v:145/147、rtl/spi_clgen.v:74/88/90、rtl/spi_shift.v:95/109/120/122/129/234），综合通常忽略延迟；rtl/spi_top.v:137 case default 赋 32'bx

existing_sdc.basis: constraints/timing.sdc:1 create_clock [get_ports wb_clk_i] -period 5；wb_clk_i 为 spi_top 主时钟输入端口 (rtl/spi_top.v:58)，端口名与顶层匹配，适用

ports.name: wb_clk_i
ports.basis: rtl/spi_top.v:58 主时钟输入；rtl/spi_top.v:142/151/163/174/212/236 posedge wb_clk_i 使用

ports.name: wb_rst_i
ports.basis: rtl/spi_top.v:59 复位输入，rtl/spi_top.v:142-144 用于异步复位

ports.name: sclk_pad_o
ports.basis: rtl/spi_top.v:73，由 spi_clgen 的 clk_out 驱动 (rtl/spi_top.v:275-277, rtl/spi_clgen.v:85-91)，SPI 串行时钟

clocks.name: wb_clk_i
clocks.basis: rtl/spi_top.v:58 顶层主时钟输入，rtl/spi_top.v:142 等 posedge wb_clk_i；spi_clgen/spi_shift 的 clk 经 rtl/spi_top.v:275/279 接同一时钟

clocks.name: sclk_pad_o
clocks.basis: rtl/spi_clgen.v:85-91 clk_out 在 posedge clk_in（wb_clk_i，rtl/spi_top.v:275）上翻转产生分频时钟，输出接 sclk_pad_o (rtl/spi_top.v:276)；分频比由 divider 寄存器决定，静态不可确定

resets.basis: rtl/spi_top.v:142-144 always @(posedge wb_clk_i or posedge wb_rst_i) 且 if (wb_rst_i)，高有效异步复位；同模式 rtl/spi_clgen.v:71-74、rtl/spi_shift.v:92-95；rtl/spi_top.v:59 注释称 synchronous 但代码为异步

io_clock_associations.basis: rtl/spi_top.v:104-110 地址译码在 wb_clk_i 域使用
rtl/spi_top.v:279-284 接 shift.p_in，rtl/spi_shift.v:131-141 在 posedge clk (wb_clk_i) 锁存
rtl/spi_top.v:178-271 在 wb_clk_i 域寄存器写入中使用
rtl/spi_top.v:160 assign wb_err_o = 1'b0 常数输出，无时钟路径
rtl/spi_top.v:236-273 ss 寄存器 posedge wb_clk_i，rtl/spi_top.v:273 组合输出
rtl/spi_clgen.v:85-91 由 wb_clk_i 分频产生 (rtl/spi_top.v:275-277)
rtl/spi_shift.v:126-235/234 在 posedge clk (wb_clk_i) 采样 s_in (rtl/spi_top.v:279/285)

clock_relationships.basis: sclk_pad_o 由 wb_clk_i 经 spi_clgen 分频计数器/翻转寄存器同源产生 (rtl/spi_top.v:275-277, rtl/spi_clgen.v:71-91)

unresolved: sclk_pad_o 的分频比取决于运行时可编程 divider 寄存器 (rtl/spi_top.v:174-209, rtl/spi_clgen.v:71-91)，静态无法确定 divide_by，仅位宽 SPI_DIVIDER_LEN=16 固定 (rtl/spi_defines.v:47/54-56)
rtl/spi_top.v:59 注释将 wb_rst_i 描述为 synchronous active high，与代码异步复位结构 (rtl/spi_top.v:142-144) 不一致，已按代码识别为异步，实际复位风格需调用方确认
